items.title: Kollar: under depth and dimension hypotheses the Picard map from the punctured spectrum to the punctured spectrum mod f is injective

items.difficulty_reason: The retained proof is a complete argument: it identifies kernel membership with extendability to an invertible coherent triple, uses the Hilbert polynomial machinery of Proposition hilbert-triple and Lemma nonnegative-chi-triple to produce a polynomial P bounding the Euler characteristics, then proves a linear upper bound for P(n) by analysing the map on H2_m via Matlis duality (dualizing complex, support of Ext with depth-dimension inequalities ruled out by assumption (4)) and a carefully chosen nonvanishing section t; the special finite-length case is worked out first to organize the general bound. Retained author proof at lines 8751-8904.
